title: Temporary JSON compat shims live in a dedicated *_json.go file, marked for removal
answers: Where to put a temporary UnmarshalJSON backwards-compat shim for an app type
How Grafana app-platform schema migrations note that a compat layer is temporary
body: When adding a custom UnmarshalJSON to make a type backwards-compatible with a legacy stored format, put it in a separate file named <type>_json.go alongside the generated type file rather than editing the generated type file itself, and add a comment stating the shim is temporary and why/when it can be removed (e.g. 'remove once legacy policies are cleared'). See apps/alerting/alertrulequality/pkg/apis/alertrulequality/v0alpha1/field_requirement_json.go next to the generated FieldRequirement type, with matching tests in field_requirement_json_test.go.
applies: apps/*/pkg/apis/*/v0alpha1 generated types in the app-platform monorepo
